The vendor directly providing **Bitbucket** at **bitbucket.org** is **Atlassian** (legally operating as **Atlassian Pty Ltd**).

### Evidence & Provider Statement
* **Exact Product & Domain:** Bitbucket / Bitbucket Cloud (`bitbucket.org`).
* **Provider Terms:** In the *Atlassian Product-Specific Terms* (supplementing the *Atlassian Customer Agreement*), products including Bitbucket Cloud (governed under Section 3, *"Additional Bitbucket Cloud Terms"*) fall under the contracting entity table as *"All Products not named elsewhere in this table"*, designating the direct contracting provider as **Atlassian Pty Ltd**.
